newsitem.title: CHINA: World's tallest building set for China.
newsitem.headline: World's tallest building set for China.

text.p: Japan's Mori Building Co will break ground for the construction of the world's tallest building in the Chinese city of Shanghai on August 27 with completion expected in 2001, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.

The building, the World Financial Centre in the Pudong development zone to the east of Shanghai's city centre, will be 460 metres and 94 storeys high with a price tag of US$960 million, the spokesman said.
It will be eight metres higher than the current world record-holder, the Petronas Twin Towers in the Malaysian capital of Kuala Lumpur.

The project will be jointly funded by Mori's Forest Overseas Co Ltd and more than 30 banks and financial institutions. Mori has 30 percent of the project and the Overseas Economic Cooperation Fund of Japan has 20 percent, the spokesman said.
